summary_en: This study tests CTX-009 alone and CTX-009 combined with CTX-471 in adults with recurrent glioblastoma. CTX-009 is given into a vein over 60 minutes (plus or minus 5 minutes) every 2 weeks in 28-day cycles, and CTX-471 is given into a vein over 30 minutes every 2 weeks on days 1 and 15 in the combination arms. The record does not name a primary outcome; it states that the study will evaluate safety and efficacy, and it is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba CTX-009 solo y CTX-009 combinado con CTX-471 en adultos con glioblastoma recurrente. CTX-009 se administra por vena durante 60 minutos (más o menos 5 minutos) cada 2 semanas en ciclos de 28 días, y CTX-471 se administra por vena durante 30 minutos cada 2 semanas, los días 1 y 15, en los brazos de combinación. El registro no indica un resultado principal; señala que el estudio evaluará la seguridad y la eficacia, y es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Recurrent grade 4 IDH wild-type glioma after standard treatment, with no more than 2 recurrences.
Karnofsky performance status (KPS) of 60% or higher.
Blood counts, liver and kidney function within the limits defined in the record.
Agree to use adequate contraception during the study and for 4 months after treatment ends.
not_for: Progressed on bevacizumab, or stopped an anti-VEGF therapy because of a clinically significant reaction.
Chemotherapy within 4 weeks, or other anti-cancer, investigational, or immunotherapy within set time windows.
History of intraparenchymal or subdural hemorrhage.
Certain heart conditions in the past 5 years, such as heart failure, heart attack, or uncontrolled arrhythmia.
